summary: Big A Mountain tower (Russell/Buchanan Co., VA): a 1963 survey describes a ~100 ft glass-cabin fire tower; listed standing; summit privately owned; no build or staffing record found.

facts.design: Glass-enclosed cabin on four steel legs, per a 1963 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description
facts.status_note: Listed standing by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; the SummitPost page mentions only phone and law enforcement towers on the peak, so the fire tower's current state is unconfirmed

access.note: SummitPost: summit privately owned; no source names the tower's owner; do not climb, ask the summit's owner before any visit

facts.agency: Unknown (SummitPost describes the summit as privately owned)

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey station description names the Big A Mountain Fire Tower: about 100 ft high, glass-enclosed cabin on four steel legs; no construction date given

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Not resolved. The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as standing; the SummitPost page names only phone and law enforcement towers on the summit and does not mention a fire tower. Reported as listed; current condition unconfirmed.

notes_for_editor: Only one period source: the 1963 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description, reproduced on the Forest Lookouts page. No construction date, builder, staffing, or fire history found in that page, the FFLOS Virginia list, SummitPost, or two WebSearch queries (neither returned a history). The NHLR and FFLOS caches hold no page for this tower. 100 ft is converted to 30.5 m. Access is private per SummitPost; the 1963 gate-and-trail directions on the Forest Lookouts page are deliberately left out. Next checks if wanted: Virginia Department of Forestry records, Russell and Buchanan county newspapers, and an NHLR listing check.
